title: Create Account
content:
Title: Create Account
Category: ACCOUNT | Intent: create_account
Typical Customer Questions:
- How do I sign up for a new customer account?
- Do I need an account to make a purchase or can I checkout as guest?
- Creating an account for rewards points.

Support Policy / Resolution:
To register an account, click 'Sign Up' at the top right of the homepage, enter your email and password, and verify your email address via the confirmation link sent to your inbox.

title: Delete Account
content:
Title: Delete Account
Category: ACCOUNT | Intent: delete_account
Typical Customer Questions:
- How do I permanently delete my account and personal data?
- Close my account and purge my personal information.

Support Policy / Resolution:
Under privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA), you can request account deletion by submitting a data erasure request in Account Privacy Settings. Your account, profile data, and saved payment methods will be permanently erased within 30 days.
policy_text: Under privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA), you can request account deletion by submitting a data erasure request in Account Privacy Settings. Your account, profile data, and saved payment methods will be permanently erased within 30 days.

Typical Customer Questions:

title: Recover Password
content:
Title: Recover Password
Category: ACCOUNT | Intent: recover_password
Typical Customer Questions:
- I forgot my password and cannot sign in.
- My account is locked after too many failed password attempts.
- How do I reset my account login credentials?

Support Policy / Resolution:
Click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen and enter your registered email. A secure password reset link will be sent to your email, valid for 60 minutes.

title: Apply Promotional Discount
content:
Title: Apply Promotional Discount
Category: BILLING | Intent: apply_promotional_discount
Typical Customer Questions:
- My coupon code did not apply at checkout.
- Can you apply a discount promo code after I already paid?
- The 20 percent off coupon was not deducted from my invoice.

Support Policy / Resolution:
Promotional codes must be entered in the promo code field before finalizing order payment. If a valid promotional code failed to apply due to a technical error, contact billing support with your order number for a retroactive credit adjustment.

title: Dispute Charge
content:
Title: Dispute Charge
Category: BILLING | Intent: dispute_charge
Typical Customer Questions:
- I see an unfamiliar charge on my bank statement from your store.
- I was charged twice for the same order.

Support Policy / Resolution:
If you notice an unrecognized charge, please verify if an authorized family member made a purchase. To dispute an erroneous charge, provide the date, last 4 digits of the card, and amount to billing support for immediate review.

title: Payment Issue
content:
Title: Payment Issue
Category: BILLING | Intent: payment_issue
Typical Customer Questions:
- My credit card was declined at checkout.
- Why does my transaction say payment authorization failed?
- Checkout keeps rejecting my card.

Support Policy / Resolution:
Payment failures typically occur due to insufficient funds, incorrect CVV or billing zip codes, or automated bank security blocks. Please verify your billing address or try an alternative payment method.

title: Cancel Order
content:
Title: Cancel Order
Category: CANCELLATION | Intent: cancel_order
Typical Customer Questions:
- I want to cancel my order immediately.
- Please stop shipment and cancel order #98234.
- I changed my mind, how do I cancel my order?

Support Policy / Resolution:
Orders may be cancelled free of charge within 30 minutes of placement before warehouse dispatch. Once an order is processed for packing, it cannot be cancelled and must be returned after delivery.

title: Check Cancellation Fee
content:
Title: Check Cancellation Fee
Category: CANCELLATION | Intent: check_cancellation_fee
Typical Customer Questions:
- Is there a penalty or fee for cancelling my order?
- Do you charge a restocking fee if I cancel after it ships?
- Will I get all my money back if I cancel?

Support Policy / Resolution:
There are no cancellation fees if the order is cancelled within the 30-minute grace period. Custom-manufactured items and expedited freight shipments may be subject to a 15% restocking fee if cancelled after processing starts.
policy_text: There are no cancellation fees if the order is cancelled within the 30-minute grace period. Custom-manufactured items and expedited freight shipments may be subject to a 15% restocking fee if cancelled after processing starts.

title: Change Order
content:
Title: Change Order
Category: ORDER | Intent: change_order
Typical Customer Questions:
- Can I add another item to an order I just placed?
- I selected the wrong size, how do I change the order?
- How do I switch the color of an item in my order?

Support Policy / Resolution:
We cannot modify items or quantities in an existing order once submitted. You may place a new order for additional items, or cancel the current order within 30 minutes and reorder.

title: Get Refund
content:
Title: Get Refund
Category: REFUND | Intent: get_refund
Typical Customer Questions:
- How do I request a refund for an item I purchased?
- What is your refund policy window?

Support Policy / Resolution:
Full refunds are available within 30 days of purchase for unused items in original packaging. To initiate a refund, submit a return request through the Returns Portal or contact customer service.

title: Refund Damaged Item
content:
Title: Refund Damaged Item
Category: REFUND | Intent: refund_damaged_item
Typical Customer Questions:
- My package arrived broken and damaged. How do I get a refund?
- The item inside the box was cracked during delivery.
- Received a defective product, I need an immediate reimbursement.
- What photos or evidence do I need to submit to get a refund for a broken item?
- Can I get a refund if the delivery box arrived crushed and the goods inside are ruined?

Support Policy / Resolution:
For items that arrive damaged or defective, we provide an immediate free replacement or 100% refund without requiring return shipping. Please provide your order number and photos of the damaged item.

title: Delivery Options
content:
Title: Delivery Options
Category: SHIPPING | Intent: delivery_options
Typical Customer Questions:
- What delivery methods and speeds are available?
- Do you offer overnight delivery?
- How long does standard delivery take to arrive?

Support Policy / Resolution:
We offer Standard Shipping (3-5 business days), Expedited Shipping (2 business days), and Next-Day Express Delivery. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on weight and destination.

- Change standard shipping to next day delivery.

title: Track Shipment
content:
Title: Track Shipment
Category: SHIPPING | Intent: track_shipment
Typical Customer Questions:
- How can I track the carrier delivering my package?
- Tracking says my package is delayed in transit.

Support Policy / Resolution:
Once your order dispatches, you will receive an email containing a carrier tracking link (FedEx, UPS, or USPS). You can also monitor live carrier tracking in the Orders tab of your account.
